title: ResponseBoard status
description: One LLM run's result in a shape the board can draw without reading prose. Written by the LLM (instruction file), a hook, or an extractor that reads the final response.

path.description: Folder the run worked in. Forward slashes.

source.description: Which LLM tool produced the run. The board shows it but never branches on it.

written_by.description: llm = the model wrote this file itself; hook = a tool hook wrote it; extractor = built afterwards from the final response text; manual = a person or script wrote it with the rb command.

id.description: Leave it out: rb gives each run an id. The same id again replaces that run (a fix of the same run).

finished_at.description: Leave it out: rb writes the time it records the run. An LLM does not know the time.

asks.description: Only decisions that need the user. Empty means nothing to answer.

not_done.description: What this run left for later, could not do, or decided not to do, with why. Shown as "left" next to what was done, grouped by where each item went.

task.description: Where the rest went: the id of a task in tasks that holds it.

drop.description: true when it was decided not to do it at all. With neither task nor drop the item is left behind.

notes.description: The long explanation. Folded by default.

from_next.description: true when this run took up the previous run's next. A previous next that this run neither took up, kept as next, nor wrote in not_done is shown as left behind.

next.description: What to pick up next, written so that a reader coming back later can start without rereading the conversation.

title.description: The next piece of work, one line.

detail.description: What it is, why it is next, and what decides when it is done.

steps.description: The first concrete steps, in order.

task.description: The id of the matching item in tasks, if there is one.

section.description: The stretch of work this run belongs to. A project has many sections over time; the history is grouped by them.

id.description: Stable key of the section. Default: the title before ":" ("第 4 段: ..." -> "第 4 段"). tasks[].section refers to it.

section.description: The id of the section this task belongs to.

detail.description: What the task is and what decides when it is done. Carried over between runs with the rest of tasks.

history.description: Earlier runs of this project, newest last. Filled from the history database by rb; do not write it by hand.

left_behind.description: not_done items of this project that have neither task nor drop yet, newest last. Filled by rb; do not write it by hand. Pick one up by writing it again in run.not_done with the same title and a task or drop.

runStatus.description: done = nothing for the user to do; needs_you = asks is not empty; failed = stopped on an error; running = still working.
